versions.changelog: Fix: removed misleading zero external dependencies claim. Description now accurately states requests library and QUIVER_API_KEY are required.
Scraper now exits with error if QUIVER_API_KEY env var is not set. No silent fallback.
Improve discoverability: add politician, senator, representative keywords to description.
Fix: cron example no longer inlines API key. Source from profile/.env instead.
Declare QUIVER_API_KEY as required env var. Use user cron instead of system cron. Add network/data transparency section.
Fix: description now correctly references SQLite instead of MongoDB. Added QUIVER_API_KEY env var requirement to metadata.

Initial release of congress-trades skill:

- Monitors US Congress stock trades in real-time via Quiver Quant API.
- Automatically syncs trades to SQLite and tracks unique trades.
- Detects and alerts on new trades above a customizable $15,000 threshold.
- Sends trade alerts via OpenClaw message system using a file-based handoff.
- Keeps a local history of the latest 50 trade alerts for review.
- Fully configurable through environment variables or script edits.
